title.zh: 【NBA 与 Kalshi、Polymarket 达成预测市场合作协议】
title.en: 【NBA 与 Kalshi、Polymarket 达成预测市场合作协议】

current_state.zh: The NBA signed partnership deals making Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction-market platforms — with official league data, branding, broadcast ads and league approval of NBA markets — alongside a CFTC memorandum of understanding and an expanded DraftKings tie-up.
current_state.en: The NBA signed partnership deals making Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction-market platforms — with official league data, branding, broadcast ads and league approval of NBA markets — alongside a CFTC memorandum of understanding and an expanded DraftKings tie-up.
